description: This file implements the class TELCOVOICEMgrHal with methods for initializing, configuring, and retrieving telephony voice management parameters via JSON interface, including capabilities, line stats, voice profiles, and physical interfaces.

classes.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal
classes.description: HAL class for telephony voice management, providing initialization, parameter get/set, and statistics retrieval functions.

methods.name: testmodulepre_requisites
methods.description: Registers TDK with the CR, returns 'SUCCESS'.

methods.name: testmodulepost_requisites
methods.description: Unregisters TDK with the CR, returns TEST_SUCCESS.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Registers all TELCOVOICEMgrHal methods, returns TEST_SUCCESS.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_Init
methods.description: Initializes the HAL with configuration file, updates response with success or failure.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_InitData
methods.description: Initializes data with given status, updates response accordingly.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_GetParamValue
methods.description: Retrieves parameter value via JSON request, updates response.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_SetParamValue
methods.description: Sets parameter value via JSON request, updates response.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_GetLineStats
methods.description: Retrieves line statistics, formats detailed info into response.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_GetCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities info, formats into response.

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_GetVoiceProfile

methods.name: TELCOVOICEMgrHal_GetPhyInterface
methods.description: Retrieves physical interface info, updates response.
